description: Omit exact recorded expenses from reports, insights and exports, or restore them (leave out, exclude, don't count). First search_expenses for full expenseId values. A grounded preview is automatic with confirm omitted/false: show exact rows (date, merchant, amount), count and skips, ask once, then repeat identical operationId, action and expenseIds with confirm:true. Premature confirmation returns preview. Omit is reversible and keeps the spreadsheet row; never deletes. Rows on a submitted report are skipped and stay on it. Act only on rows the user chose; never decide rows are duplicates or personal. Recategorize: correct_expenses. Result gives applied/skipped/conflicted/failed counts and Undo. Over 100 rows: https://www.expensebot.ai/review-expenses?source=mcp.

action.description: omit hides rows from reports, insights and exports; restore puts omitted rows back.

confirm.description: Omit/false previews only; true only after the user approves the preview.

expenseIds.description: Full expenseId (Column Q Receipt ID) values from search_expenses; never dates, rows or merchants.

operationId.description: Idempotency key; generate once and reuse unchanged to confirm.

reason.description: The user's own short reason, shown in the Omitted view. Never invent one.

name: omit_expenses

skipped.description: By reason: ALREADY_OMITTED, ALREADY_ACTIVE, ON_REPORT, NOT_FOUND, SPLIT_OR_SHARED_ID, ENTITLEMENT.
